description: Use when someone asks whether a lab or point-of-care analyzer will connect to their EHR, LIS or practice system, or how to get analyzer results into the patient record without retyping (e.g. 'will my Sysmex XP-300 work with athenahealth?', 'connect Abbott i-STAT to Epic', 'Roche cobas b 101 to SystmOne', 'Siemens CLINITEK to EMIS', 'Tosoh AIA-900 to eClinicalWorks'). Fuzzy-matches the analyzer and the record system and returns: connection status (live, driver built, connectable via standard protocol with a published guide, or custom driver needed), the analyzer protocol (HL7 v2, ASTM, POCT1-A2), the physical link, how results pass through an on-site gateway, the record-system route, what is needed on site, questions to ask any vendor, and page links. Works for unknown analyzers too. Does not interpret results.

analyzer.description: Analyzer make and/or model as the user wrote it, e.g. 'sysmex kx21n', 'i-STAT', 'Afinion 2'.

country.description: Country of the site, e.g. 'UK' or 'US', if known.

ehr.description: EHR, LIS, LIMS or practice system, e.g. 'athena', 'eCW', 'Epic', 'SystmOne', 'EMIS Web'. Omit if not mentioned.

name: check_connectivity
title: Check if a lab analyzer connects to an EHR or LIS
